blockingFindings.title: Preserve assigned-Plan eligibility before treating cross-Plan context as dispatchable
blockingFindings.counterexample: Selected Plan selected is active with pointer Action a. The caller owns a live reservation for Action b with matching Project, branch and claim generation. Put b in an otherwise valid Plan assigned with status:draft. The new cross-Plan branch replaces the already-validated selected Plan with assigned but never checks assigned eligibility or an explicit source-assignment authority record. runNextReadOnlyCommand returns context.planStatus=draft, blockers=[], dispatchable=true and Continue the caller-owned Action within existing authority. resolveProjectTransition/advance use this same newly broadened resolveDispatch path.
blockingFindings.impact: A claim alone now makes unfinished work in an unactivated Plan appear executable. The preexisting active-Plan gate was evaluated against a different Plan, and shared dispatch behavior is widened outside the bounded read-only orientation correction. The operator accepted an inactive Plan and a specifically bounded source assignment, not blanket execution authority for arbitrary claimed draft Plans.
blockingFindings.criterion: REQ-002 and final criterion: preserve existing authority/readiness gates; observation must not authorize work or modify live control/admission policy.
blockingFindings.recommendation: Keep assigned B visible separately from selected A; retain the existing canonical eligibility/authority boundary for executable dispatch. If separately assigned inactive source work is supported, verify that supported explicit scoped authority rather than treating any reservation as that grant. Do not activate the Plan or change production pointers to repair the reader.

The second assertion fails: actual true. This only changes disposable fixtures.
